reviewer.role: Acceptance reviewer; did not produce the run answer

case.must_observe.1.rationale: Retains all upstream packet/extraction/source/document IDs, synthetic_manual_transcription method, AI-use conditions, objective-section-only/full versus approval-table-partial coverage, warnings and UNVERIFIED status. Locators and upstream evidence ID stay attached to interpreted facts.

case.must_observe.2.rationale: Keeps the blurred approver raw value G... đốc, normalized null, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED and unresolved authority. Legible statements are only provisional documented activities; shift-lead review is not silently upgraded to approval authority or performed control.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: No claimed specialist/OCR execution, cloud upload or promotion of upstream UNVERIFIED data. Local trace confirms consumer-only reading; proposals and business approvals remain distinct from extraction status.

variant.must_observe.1.rationale: Explicitly identifies the packet as fictional consumer-only data rather than output of a real Document-Evidence/OCR run and does not invoke either capability.

limitations: Reviewer authored fixture/skill but not the answering run; not third-party assurance.
Validates consumption of a synthetic packet only; it cannot establish live specialist extraction or OCR capability.
Exact model identity unavailable; executor-maintained trace is not a complete host transcript.
